listings.title: Free Surya Kriya Taster Class
listings.description: Free taster session of Surya Kriya, a powerful ancient yoga from the Isha tradition. Gentle upa-yoga, guided practice, and Q&A about the full weekend retreat at Reduce Gesundheitszentrum. No experience needed.

listings.title: Rooftop Jazz Night
listings.description: Live jazz on the rooftop — quartet, sunset, and a bar with local wine.

listings.title: Repair Café Linz
listings.description: Bring your broken things — volunteers fix them with you. Free coffee, tools provided.

listings.title: Astrophotography Workshop
listings.description: Night-sky photography under dark skies. Tripods provided, bring any camera.

listings.title: Mobile Massage
listings.description: Relaxing 60-minute massage at your home or office.

listings.title: Home Repair Visit
listings.description: Free first consultation visit — small repairs around the house.

listings.title: Vinyl & Coffee Market
listings.description: Crates of second-hand vinyl, local roasters, and a repair corner for turntables.

listings.title: Open-Air Cinema: Sci-Fi Classics
listings.description: Retro sci-fi double feature under the stars — blankets and mulled wine available.

listings.title: Trivia Night at the Aquarium
listings.description: Teams of four, five rounds, and the aquarium's jellyfish room as the tie-break stage.

listings.title: Guided Bauhaus Walking Tour
listings.description: Two-hour architecture walk through the Bauhaus masters' estate with a local historian.

listings.title: Barista for one morning shift
listings.description: Weekend morning shift at a specialty coffee stand (Markthalle Neun). Espresso machine experience helpful; training on our setup included. Paid per shift into escrow, released at end of shift.

listings.title: Photographer for farmers market
listings.description: Cover our farmers-market stall (Karmelitermarkt, 8:00-13:00): candid shots for next season's socials. Deliver 20+ edited photos within a week. Escrow releases on delivery.
